findings.summary: Override save can disable an enabled catalog item when item data is not resolved
findings.details: ItemConfigPanel renders an active Save button while item is still derived from an async paginated search result. If the admin submits before that query resolves, or if search: catalogItemId does not return the exact row, item is undefined and the mutation sends enabled: false.
findings.tierReason: alreadyHandled=true — enabled prop now passed from parent row (reliable source); Save button disabled while isLoading || !item
findings.recommendation: Block submission until the exact item/config has loaded, show an error if it cannot be found, and preserve the current enabled state from a reliable source such as a detail endpoint or the row passed into the sheet.

findings.summary: Tenant catalog configuration is capped at the first 20 items
findings.details: The table hard-codes { page: 0, pageSize: 20 } and never exposes pagination, search, or fetch-all. Any catalog item after the first page cannot be enabled, disabled, or configured.
findings.recommendation: Add pagination/search/infinite loading, or surface when totalElements exceeds the loaded count.

findings.summary: Regional rows show inherited regions as disabled regardless of tenant default
findings.details: config?.enabled ?? false always shows off for rows without an override, misrepresenting the effective enabled state which may be inherited as on.
findings.recommendation: Pass the effective tenant/default regional availability into RegionalConfigMatrix and render inherited rows with the actual effective state.

classificationRules.blockingThreshold: severity critical/high AND confidence >= 0.70 AND not alreadyHandled
classificationRules.advisoryThreshold: severity medium/low OR confidence < 0.70 OR alreadyHandled
